title: Watercolor Retreat Vacation Rental
meta_description: Watercolor Retreat is a 5.00 bedroom, 4.50 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: DescriptionWaterColor RetreatWaterColor Beach CommunityE Royal Fern Way, Santa Rosa Beach, FL 32459Welcome to WaterColor Retreat, a luxury home for guests who want the WaterColor lifestyle without the crowds. Thoughtfully designed around outdoor living, this meticulously maintained residence offers generous space, privacy, and upscale finishes in a quieter area of WaterColor. Ideal for multigenerational families and grandparents, itprovides resort-style living done right — private, comfortable, and perfectly suited for relaxed coastal stays. Private Courtyard Pool & Outdoor LivingEnjoyment starts with the heart of the home - the courtyard and outdoor living whichfeatures:Private saltwater pool measuring 15' x 16' plus a sun ledge -perfect play space for children after a long day at the beach!Large screened porchGas firepitBuilt-in grill area with TVMultiple outdoor seating and lounging spacesWhether you’re starting the morning poolside or unwinding after a beach day, theoutdoor living spaces offer a calm, relaxed setting away from busier areas of thecommunity.Interior Living & DesignWith approximately 3,300 square feet of interior living space and 1,300 square feet of outdoor living, this home comfortably accommodates families and groups while stillallowing everyone their own space.Highlights include:Open-concept living and dining areas with 12’ ceilingsAbundant natural lightWell-appointed kitchen with Thermador appliances and wine chiller making it ideal for family meals or entertainingSeamless flow between indoor spaces and the courtyardThe layout is designed for comfortable, upscale living.Sleeping AccommodationsFive well-appointed bedrooms provide flexibility for families, couples, and multi-generational groups.5 Bedrooms | 4.5 BathroomsSleeps up to 12 guests comfortablyBedrooms are thoughtfully arranged to support both privacy and convenience.Amenities & FeaturesPrivate 15' x 16' Saltwater Pool with Sun Ledge: Fenced courtyard with lounging areas and outdoor TV.6-Seater Golf Cart: Included for easy cruising around the WaterColor community.Outdoor Gas Grill: Built-in for BBQs and cookouts.Screened-In Porch: With direct pool access.Outdoor Shower & Gas Fire Pit: Great for evenings and beach comebacks.Parking: Space for 4 vehicles plus golf cart storage.Additional Perks: Washer/dryer, fast Wi-Fi, and bicycles included seasonally.Pets: Not pet-friendly.Location & Community BenefitsWaterColor is a 500-acre coastal community known for its charming pedestrian-friendly layout and abundant amenities. Staying here gives you access to:WaterColor Beach Club & Private Beach Access — beachfront pools and lounge areas (amenity passes included with rentals).Camp WaterColor — large pools with water slides, lazy river, playgrounds and sports courts.Multiple Community Pools, Parks, & Trails — ideal for walking, biking, and relaxation.WaterColor Shuttle, Tennis, and Pickleball Courts – entertainment for all!Amenity access is subject to community rules, seasonal availability, and operational changes beyond the owner’s control.Nearby destinations include Seaside, Grayton Beach, and Seagrove Beach,restaurants and shopping all within a short ride.Why Guests Choose This HomePrivate courtyard pool and multiple outdoor living areasSpacious interior layout ideal for families and groupsComfortable, upscale atmosphereExcellent balance of resort access and residential calmExperience 30A at a Higher LevelFrom sugar-white beaches and bike trails to boutique shopping and coastal dining, WaterColor remains one of 30A’s most sought-after destinations. WaterColor Retreatprovides a refined home base for enjoying it all at your own pace.Important Information for GuestsThis is a non-smoking and non-vaping propertyNo events, parties, or gatherings beyond registered guestsQuiet hours: 10:00 PM – 8:00 AMOccupancy limited to registered guests onlyOutdoor areas are not fully enclosed and may be visible from nearby homesGolf cart use requires licensed drivers and adherence to community rulesDamage Insurance protection is included with your reservation. Please report any damage or missing items promptly. By booking, guests agree to comply with house rules, community standards, and all applicable local regulations. Failure to comply may result in fines, loss of amenities, or early termination of the stay without refund, as permitted by platform policies.Note: Guests 5 years and older require a wristband for community amenities. Maximum 12 guests per home.Golf Cart InformationProvided as a guest amenity; not guaranteed by 30A Cottages or OwnerRepairs or replacements are outside property management controlRentals through Electric Cart Company available on a first-come, first-served basisPool HeatingAvailable October–April for an additional feeWeather permitting; not available below 50°F or above 80°FParkingDesignated parking for 4 vehicles; golf cart stored in mini-garageVehicle registration is required prior to arrivalReservation & Booking Policy50% due at booking; balance due 60 days prior (or full if within 60 days)Cancellations over 60 days: initial payment fully refundable (less 5% processing fee)Optional travel insurance availableNot Pet FriendlyCheck-in: 4:00 PM CST | Check-out: 10:00 AM CSTMinimum age for booking: 25 and must be an occupant during the entire rental period.
rooms_guidance: 1st Floor King Guest Master #1: King - French doors leading to covered porch
2nd Floor Primary King Bedroom: King - Spacious, private covered porch
2nd Floor Guest Bedroom (2 Queen Beds): 2 Queen Beds - Hallway Bathroom shared with Bunk Room
2nd Floor Bunk Room (3 Twins): 3 Twins - Hallway Bathroom shared Guest Bedroom with Queen Beds
